scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Whoa, long time no see! But weren't you supposed to be dead?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
哇，好久不见！
不过，你不是已经死了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Ah, you must have been reborn. Well, I'm glad to have you back.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
啊，原来你转生了。
很高兴你能回来。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
I'm sorry, but I don't think you're ready to learn magic yet. Why don't you go finish learning the Basic Skills first?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
抱歉，你还没准备好学习魔法。
不如先去把基本技能学完吧？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Take your time. The more you learn, the more ready you'll be to learn magic again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
慢慢来。
多学些东西，才能为重新学习魔法做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Well, since you have passed the Mage test once, I will not question your qualification. You want to have your magic skills back immediately, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
既然你已经通过一次魔法师考试，我就不再质疑你的资格了。
你想马上恢复魔法能力，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wow, for some reason, you look way better than you did before. Anyway, I believe you will do a better job being a Mage as well.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
哇，不知道为什么，你看起来比以前好看多了。
总之，我相信你也会成为更出色的魔法师。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Is there anything more I can help you with? If not, why don't you go test your skills? The world is waiting for you~!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
还有什么需要我帮忙的吗？
没有的话，就去试试你的本领吧。
这个世界正等着你呢~！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
What, are you interested in the Mage guild? I didn't want to tell you this, but you don't belong here.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
怎么，你对魔法师公会感兴趣？
我本来不想说的，可这里不是你该来的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
I am not sure why you're still standing in front of me, but I can tell that you're not meant to be a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
不知道你为什么还站在我面前，不过我看得出来，你不适合当魔法师。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yo. What's up?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嘿，有什么事？

scripts.text: I want to be a Mage.
scripts.translation: 我想成为魔法师

scripts.text: Tell me the Requirements.
scripts.translation: 告诉我转职条件

scripts.text: Pretty much nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么事

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey, haven't you realized? You're aleady a Mage, silly!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嘿，你没发现吗？
你已经是魔法师了，傻瓜！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey~ C'mon. Quit playing games. You can't be a Mage because you already have another Job.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嘿~别闹了。
你已经有其他职业，不能再当魔法师了。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh...?
Hey, look at you! You're kinda cute~! Not my type though...
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
想当魔法师啊...？
嘿，你长得还挺可爱~！
不过，不是我喜欢的类型...

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh...?
Oooh, you're such a hot babe~!
I like girls like you~
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
想当魔法师啊...？
哦，你真是个大美女~！
我喜欢像你这样的女孩~

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
Oh, what a bummer. You haven't met the requirements yet.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嗯？
准备好了...？
哎呀，真可惜，你还没满足条件呢。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
{0}'s test was...
Making Mixed Solution No. 1.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嗯？
准备好了...？
{0}的考试内容是...
制作1号混合溶液。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
{0}'s test was...
Making Mixed Solution No. 2.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嗯？
准备好了...？
{0}的考试内容是...
制作2号混合溶液。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
{0}'s test was...
Making Mixed Solution No. 3.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嗯？
准备好了...？
{0}的考试内容是...
制作3号混合溶液。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
{0}'s test was...
Making Mixed Solution No. 4.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嗯？
准备好了...？
{0}的考试内容是...
制作4号混合溶液。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
One of these days you'll realize the power inside of you when you can make Fire with your mind!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
总有一天，当你能凭意念生出火焰时，就会明白自己体内蕴藏的力量！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Right, you said that you wanna be a Mage? Alright then, please sign the Mage Application.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
对了，你说想当魔法师，是吧？
那就在魔法师申请表上签名吧。

scripts.text: Sign Up.
scripts.translation: 报名

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Okay. Sign right there. Oh, you're very good at spelling. Alright. So your name is... {0}.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
好，就签在这里。
哦，名字拼得很准确嘛。
你的名字是...{0}。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now it's time for
me to give you the test.
Make me a ^3355FFMixed Solution No. 1^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
接下来，我来给你出题。
制作一份^3355FF1号混合溶液^000000，带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now it's time for
me to give you the test.
Make me a ^3355FFMixed Solution No. 2^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
接下来，我来给你出题。
制作一份^3355FF2号混合溶液^000000，带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now it's time for
me to give you the test.
Make me a ^3355FFMixed Solution No. 3^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
接下来，我来给你出题。
制作一份^3355FF3号混合溶液^000000，带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now it's time for
me to give you the test.
Make me a ^3355FFMixed Solution No. 4^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
接下来，我来给你出题。
制作一份^3355FF4号混合溶液^000000，带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You can find the necessary ingredients inside the Guide Book in this Guild. So you better look up what you need before you go.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
公会里的指南手册记着所需材料。
出发前，最好先查清楚要准备些什么。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Once you collect all the ingredients you, use the machine in the center of the room to mix the solution. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
收齐材料后，用房间中央的机器调配溶液。
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Whaaaaat~?! Right after you tell me that you wanna become a Mage, you change your mind?! Be a bit more decisive!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
什么~~？！
刚说完想当魔法师，你就改主意了？！
果断一点嘛！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Go back and reach Novice Job level 9 first. Don't forget that you also have to learn all of the Basic Skills before you come back.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
先回去把初心者的职业等级练到9级。
别忘了，还要学会所有基本技能再回来。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Okay, let me
check if you made your
solution accurately...
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
好，让我看看你的溶液配得对不对...

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey, where's the Solution
I asked for...? I can't check it if you don't show it to me, right?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嘿，我要的溶液呢...？
不拿给我看，我怎么检查？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wait.
This isn't the
Solution I asked for!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
等等，这不是我要的溶液！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hmm. I can see that you tried really hard. For a beginner's attempt, this is really good.
Great work!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嗯，看得出你很努力。
作为初学者，能做到这样已经很不错了。
干得好！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 1 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你应该制作1号混合溶液，带回来给我。
再去试一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 2 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你应该制作2号混合溶液，带回来给我。
再去试一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 3 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你应该制作3号混合溶液，带回来给我。
再去试一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 4 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你应该制作4号混合溶液，带回来给我。
再去试一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Alright! I'm pleased to say that you've passed the Mage Test. I will transform you right away!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
很好！
很高兴告诉你，你通过了魔法师考试。
现在就为你办理转职！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
*Ahem*
Congratulations!
You are now a Mage!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
*咳*
恭喜！
你现在是一名魔法师了！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
'Welcome to My World~'
Heh heh, I just wanted to say that. You know, it's a quote from a well-known movie~
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
“欢迎来到我的世界~”
嘿嘿，我就是想说这句。
这是某部著名电影里的台词哦~

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now that you're a Mage just like us, let's be friends, okay?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
现在你和我们一样，都是魔法师了。
交个朋友吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh?
For a cutie like you, I'd be happy to explain the requirements!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
想当魔法师啊？
你这么可爱，我当然乐意说明转职条件！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh?
I'd be happy to explain the requirements for a pretty girl like you!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
想当魔法师啊？
为你这样漂亮的女孩说明转职条件，我当然乐意！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
First of all, you have to reach Novice Job Level 10 and learn all of the Basic Skills. Then, you'll have to pass the Mage Test.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
首先，你的初心者职业等级必须达到10级，并学会所有基本技能。
然后，还要通过魔法师考试。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Your test is to
make me a
^3355FFMixed Solution No. 1^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你的考试内容是制作^3355FF1号混合溶液^000000，带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Your test is to
make me a
^3355FFMixed Solution No. 2^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你的考试内容是制作^3355FF2号混合溶液^000000，带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Your test is to
make me a
^3355FFMixed Solution No. 3^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你的考试内容是制作^3355FF3号混合溶液^000000，带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Your test is to
make me a
^3355FFMixed Solution No. 4^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你的考试内容是制作^3355FF4号混合溶液^000000，带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You can look up the ingredients you'll need to make the Solution inside the Guide Book in this Guild.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你可以在本公会的指南手册中查看制作溶液所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You will be informed as to which Mixed Solution you will need to create after signing the application form.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
签好申请表后，我会告诉你需要制作哪种混合溶液。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Let me know when you are ready to become a Mage, alright?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
准备好成为魔法师后，就来告诉我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Nothing...?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
没什么事...？

scripts.text:

This machine is the property of the Geffen Mage Guild and is used only for mixing solutions for magic purposes.
scripts.translation:

本机属于吉芬魔法师公会，仅用于调配魔法溶液。
